description: This file is a C source file implementing notes merging functionality in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for initializing merge options, converting paths to object IDs, verifying notes file pairs, finding merge pairs, performing tree diffs, handling conflicts, and managing notes merge workflow including commit and abort operations.

classes.name: struct notes_merge_pair
classes.description: Represents a pair of object IDs related to notes merging, including base, local, and remote states.

classes.name: struct notes_merge_options
classes.description: Holds options for merging notes, including repository reference, verbosity, merge strategy, and related metadata.

classes.name: struct notes_tree
classes.description: Represents the notes tree used during the merge process.

methods.name: void init_notes_merge_options(struct repository * r,struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Initializes notes merge options with default values and repository reference.

methods.name: int path_to_oid(const char * path,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts a file path to an object ID based on its hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: int verify_notes_filepair(struct diff_filepair * p,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Verifies consistency of diff filepair entries and extracts object IDs.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * find_notes_merge_pair_pos(struct notes_merge_pair * list,int len,struct object_id * obj,int insert_new,int * occupied)
methods.description: Finds or inserts a notes_merge_pair in a sorted list based on object ID comparison.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * diff_tree_remote(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * remote,int * num_changes)
methods.description: Computes the difference between a base and remote object ID trees, returning changes.

methods.name: void diff_tree_local(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int len,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local)
methods.description: Computes the difference between a base and local object ID trees, updating the changes list.

methods.name: int notes_merge(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * local_tree,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Main function to perform a notes merge given local and remote references, handling various merge cases.

methods.name: int notes_merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * partial_tree,struct commit * partial_commit,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Creates a commit for the notes merge, incorporating all notes from the worktree.

methods.name: int notes_merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts the notes merge by cleaning up the temporary worktree directory.

methods.name: void check_notes_merge_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Ensures the notes merge worktree exists and is properly set up.

methods.name: void write_buf_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Writes a buffer representing object data to the notes merge worktree.

methods.name: void write_note_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const struct object_id * note)
methods.description: Writes a specific note object to the worktree.

methods.name: int ll_merge_in_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p)
methods.description: Performs a low-level three-way merge of note blobs in the worktree.

methods.name: int merge_one_change_manual(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Handles a conflicting note change manually, resolving conflicts by choosing remote, local, or merge result.

methods.name: int merge_one_change(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Resolves a single note change based on the specified merge strategy.

methods.name: int merge_changes(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int * num_changes,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Merges multiple note changes and identifies conflicts.

methods.name: int merge_from_diffs(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local,const struct object_id * remote,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Performs a three-way diff merge of notes from base, local, and remote trees.
